diagnosis_summary: A Rock maintainer closed issue 6081 as a duplicate of issue 6064. The linked fix migration adds ordered staff-role allows followed by an All Users deny so the out-of-box next-generation check-in security matches version 1 check-in, and issue 6064 is labeled confirmed and fixed in 16.7. Early alpha builds shared the same displayed file version before and after the commit, so exact build ancestry matters. Existing customized matching rules may not be overwritten and still require local verification.
workaround_summaries: Follow issue 6064 for the canonical resolution, use a build proven to descend from commit c90c1459fa4d428a7a15af9f76a23dfaac9517c7, and inspect effective ordered permissions on customized next-generation check-in pages.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether customized next-generation check-in pages have the corrected ordered security rules.
prerequisites: Know the exact installed build ancestry.
Have read-only access to page security configuration.

steps.title: Check build ancestry
steps.instructions: Confirm that the installed build descends from commit c90c1459fa4d428a7a15af9f76a23dfaac9517c7 or contains an equivalent migration.
steps.expected_if_affected: The build predates the migration, or customized pages retained earlier matching rules.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The build contains the migration and the effective page rules match the corrected order.

steps.title: Inspect ordered page security
steps.instructions: View security for the next-generation check-in pages without saving. Confirm the intended staff-role allows precede the All Users deny; record role categories only, not person or group identifiers.
steps.expected_if_affected: Required staff allows are absent, ordered after the deny, or customized rules prevent the corrected effective access.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Required staff-role allows are evaluated before the All Users deny on every relevant customized page.
evidence_to_record: staff allows present yes or no
All Users deny last yes or no

limitations: The migration may intentionally avoid overwriting customized security, so fixed build ancestry alone is insufficient.

context.scope: exact source revision for out-of-box next-generation check-in page security; release package inclusion requires verification
